subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be limited to documenting the existing pi-tui multiline keys, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable send/newline keybinding surface for openclaw tui?
rationale: Current main already has dependency-backed newline insertion, but a configurable TUI preference would add public config, CLI, or keybinding surface under repository policy that deliberately raises the bar for new config.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback in docs and /help while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define a narrow TUI keybinding config or CLI surface with default and customized send/newline tests.

options.title: Fold Into Composer Backlog
options.body: Track configurable TUI send keys together with external editor, long-prompt modal, and vi-mode composer ergonomics work.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback in docs and /help while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest prior review context and adjacent send-shortcut product history for this decision.
